triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '38. CK-like prefetch depth and barrier masks do not transfer mechanically to FlyDSL no-mask' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 38. CK-like prefetch depth and barrier masks do not transfer mechanically to FlyDSL no-mask

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL Flash Attention on MI308X (gfx942) -- 38. CK-like prefetch depth and barrier masks do not transfer mechanically to FlyDSL no-mask

payload.attempted: CK FMHA uses deeper prefetch and carefully placed scheduler barriers. Copying `_QK_PREFETCH_DEPTH=3` or CK-like softmax barrier masks into FlyDSL should move the kernel closer to CK.
payload.lesson: Port scheduling constants only after ATT proves the surrounding pipeline shape matches. If the access pattern differs, treat CK constants as hypotheses, not defaults.

established_fact.mechanism: CK's constants work with CK's access pattern and scheduler template. FlyDSL's register allocation, wait placement, and QK/V staging differ enough that the same knobs perturb the schedule without reproducing CK's latency hiding.
